## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the reproducible failure or research task this change fixes.

## Evidence

For rules/adapters, include decision time, source/data mode, frozen inputs, confirmation delay and a refusal case. State any market/calendar/cost limits. Do not treat synthetic results as a trading edge.

## Validation

List relevant tests and fixture updates. For documentation-only changes, verify links and capability statements. Keep hard risk gates intact and exclude credentials/private records.
